failed.reason_text: This can happen with low light or a blurred document — it's not a strike against your account. You can try again right away.

waiting_room.title: One more step before you meet people
waiting_room.subtitle: Verification is required in your region
waiting_room.description: To keep Friending safe, members in your region must verify their identity before using the app. It takes about two minutes and your documents are never shown to other members.
